description: Create bootable Windows USB drives, clone or back up your PC, recover deleted files, securely wipe drives and check drive health
notes: DriveForge writes raw disk sectors, so it requires administrator rights and will prompt for elevation every time it starts.
It is not code-signed: SmartScreen may warn on first run. The reasons, and how to verify the download yourself, are at https://forgelabssoft.com/#code-signing
Settings and logs are kept in %LocalAppData%\DriveForge, not in the Scoop directory, so 'scoop uninstall driveforge' leaves that folder behind. Delete it by hand if you want no trace.
